pr.title: Add conditional test coverage
pr.description: Tests run with python3 -m unittest discover -s tests; default unittest warning handling, no configured lint rules.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+import unittest
+from subject import eligible_items
+
+class EligibilityTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_returns_two_positive_items(self):
+        for item in eligible_items():
+            self.assertGreater(item, 0)
